title: Ralph implementation response to one Negotiation Round
description: The Implementation Agent's machine-readable answer to a review that requested changes. Validated whole before any reply is posted; a response that does not validate is refused, never repaired.

contract.description: Exactly ralph-response/v1. A reader that does not recognise the version refuses the payload rather than guessing at its shape.

head.description: The exact commit that was reviewed — the one these findings judged, not the new head the fixes created.

round.description: The Negotiation Round being answered, counting from 1.

model.description: The exact implementation model identity, as recorded on the Story's model:impl: label.

summary.description: Prose for the response comment: what changed, and why it answers the round.

dispositions.description: One entry per open finding — every finding the round raised, answered exactly once.

id.description: The finding's stable identifier, as the reviewer issued it.

disposition.description: accepted: a fix commit was appended for it. disputed: the finding is answered with evidence instead of a change, and the code is left alone. unresolved: it was not addressed this round, and the note says why.

note.description: What was changed for this finding, or why it could not be.

evidence.description: Required for a dispute, and only meaningful there: the test, the source documentation, or the code the reviewer can read to see the finding is wrong. A dispute without it is an assertion, which is exactly what the finding contract forbids of the reviewer too.
